📡 PROJECT NOMAD RESEARCH COMPLETE

**Project N.O.M.A.D.** (Node for Offline Media, Archives, and Data) — by Chris Sherwood, Crosstalk Solutions. Open source (Apache 2.0), hit #1 GitHub trending March 2026.

**What it is:** Docker-orchestrated offline knowledge + AI server. NOT a mesh radio tool — but exactly what the GoBag drive is being built for.

**Includes:** Offline Wikipedia (Kiwix), local AI (Ollama + RAG via Qdrant), Khan Academy (Kolibri), offline maps (ProtoMaps/OSM), medical references, survival guides, CyberChef, local notes.

**Hardware:** Minimum: 4GB RAM, any Ubuntu machine. AI-capable: i7/Ryzen 7 + 32GB RAM + NVIDIA GPU.

**Mesh comms:** NOT built-in yet — community roadmap proposes Reticulum/LXMF integration. Pair with Meshtastic for radio comms now.

**GoBag verdict: ✅ HIGH RELEVANCE — Include on both drives.**
The GoBag project and NOMAD are essentially the same thing. NOMAD is a polished, free, open-source implementation of what Aaron is building manually. Bundle NOMAD installer + ZIMs + Ollama model weights on the 2TB drive.

GitHub: https://github.com/Crosstalk-Solutions/project-nomad
